WITH yearly_margin AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ProductCategoryName AS product_category,
        toYear(fs.DateKey) AS year,
        100.0 * (sum(fs.SalesAmount) - sum(fs.TotalCost)) / nullIf(sum(fs.SalesAmount), 0) AS gross_margin_pct
    FROM retail.FactSales AS fs
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON fs.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
        ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
        ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    WHERE toYear(fs.DateKey) IN (2007, 2008, 2009)
    GROUP BY
        pc.ProductCategoryName,
        toYear(fs.DateKey)
)
SELECT
    product_category,
    year,
    round(gross_margin_pct, 2) AS gross_margin_pct,
    round(gross_margin_pct - lagInFrame(gross_margin_pct, 1) OVER (
        PARTITION BY product_category
        ORDER BY year
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
    ), 2) AS yoy_change_pct_points
FROM yearly_margin
ORDER BY
    product_category,
    year
